title.zh: Vercel给Agent加上常驻后台：任务能持续处理，沙箱销毁也不丢文件
title.en: Vercel给Agent加上常驻后台：任务能持续处理，沙箱销毁也不丢文件

current_state.zh: At its Ship 2026 developer conference, Vercel launched Daemons for long-running background processes, opened Drives for persistent AI agent file storage that survives sandbox destruction, and added MCP Events to Connect so agents can subscribe to external system events.
current_state.en: At its Ship 2026 developer conference, Vercel launched Daemons for long-running background processes, opened Drives for persistent AI agent file storage that survives sandbox destruction, and added MCP Events to Connect so agents can subscribe to external system events.
